chunks: Hamzah ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alavi - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim quoted his father, on the authority of Al-Nawfaly, on the authority of Al-Sakoony, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers, on the authority of Ali (peace be upon them all)
He said: Using good scent indicates affluence. Wearing good garments indicates beauty. Having a good temper defeats one’s enemies.

key_terms.الدُّهْنُ: Perfume or oil, used here to signify the use of scent as a marker of status

ai.seo_question: What do perfume, clothing, and good manners signify according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this hadith as a practical guide to social semiotics, where external presentation serves as a mirror for internal state and a tool for social influence. While perfume and clothing signal material affluence and aesthetic appeal, the emphasis on *husn al-malka* (excellent character/manners) highlights the Shia virtue of using grace and dignity to neutralize adversaries, reflecting the concept of *hikma* (wisdom) in public conduct.
